symptom: `DESCRIBE` of a Java action (or `describe module … with all`) emits a body-less `create java action …;` that fails with `no viable alternative` and cascades into following statements — happens for add-on/Marketplace actions whose `.java` source isn't on disk
cause: Body emitted only when `readJavaActionUserCode` returns non-empty, but the grammar requires `AS DOLLAR_STRING` (body is mandatory)
insight: Always emit the `as $$ … $$;` block; when source can't be read, write a placeholder comment body. Issue #637
